text: The X-ray findings of dilated bowel loops with no rectal gas confirm a distal obstruction, which is highly suspicious for Hirschsprung disease given the failure to pass meconium. To confirm this diagnosis, I need to visualize the transition zone. REQUEST TEST: Barium_Enema

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal barium enema rules out Hirschsprung disease and suggests a distal obstruction like meconium ileus. I need to check for signs of cystic fibrosis, so REQUEST TEST: Sweat_Cl_Test

speaker: Doctor
text: A normal sweat test effectively rules out Cystic Fibrosis, which makes meconium ileus unlikely. Given the bilious vomiting, abdominal distension, and distal obstruction on X-ray with normal functional tests, I suspect a mechanical blockage such as intestinal atresia.
